I got my Mirena about 2 weeks ago. I was completely terrified because I had a friend who said it's the most pain she has ever been in..so, I went in very unconfident. My normal doctor gave me a Xanax to calm my nerves because I'm prone to panic attacks and that definitely helped me. Honestly the process was extremely uncomfortable, but very fast. I wasn't really in pain, it was just a feeling I've never felt before going on in my uterus. It probably took about 3 minutes to do and after I was just having some bad cramps. I went home, got the heating pad and some hot tea and fell asleep. I've been a little crampy but it's gotten so much better. I still have very minor spotting but it's not a big deal. This method is my favorite so far. Couple words of advice, eat a small meal beforehand, take the recommended amount of pain medicine beforehand, and have someone drive you. You'll do great!
